info.title: devkit
info.description: A markdown backlog in your repository (backlog/items/*.md with frontmatter) and the commands that keep it consistent: rebuild the index, lint, set fields, query, renumber, draw a graph. Also checks commit subjects, summarises dotnet build and test logs, and tracks test durations. Settings come from workflow.config.json.

commands.name: commit-subject
commands.description: Check a commit subject against the repository's rules

commands.name: graph
commands.description: Write the Backlog Atlas page

commands.name: init
commands.description: Start a backlog: the folders, the index and a starter workflow.config.json

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Check every item's frontmatter (--fix corrects what it can)

commands.name: log-summary
commands.description: Summarise a dotnet build or test log

commands.name: next-id
commands.description: Print the next free ID for a prefix (BL or BUG)

commands.name: query
commands.description: List the items whose frontmatter matches filters

commands.name: renumber
commands.description: Give an item a new ID and rewrite the references to it

options.name: --from
options.description: take your item from a commit (a rebase or merge collision); the working tree's file is kept

options.name: --base
options.description:
the base branch (default origin/<baseBranch in workflow.config.json>): its items are taken,
and references are rewritten
only in files changed since merge-base <ref> HEAD

options.name: --branch-tip
options.description:
the branch whose commits <base>..<ref> hold taken IDs (default: the tip a rebase in
progress started from, otherwise HEAD)

options.name: --all
options.description: rewrite references in every file (a renumber with no collision)

options.name: --apply
options.description: write the changes; without it, a dry run

commands.name: set-field
commands.description: Set one frontmatter field on items, then rebuild the index

commands.name: skills
commands.description: Write the chosen skill packs into .claude/ (--check finds stale copies)

commands.name: sync
commands.description: Rebuild backlog/BACKLOG.md from the item files

commands.name: test-timing
commands.description: Record and compare build and test durations
